interpretation.claim_scope: descriptive readout effects on the frozen tasks and horizons; no causal supervision inference or general model ranking
interpretation.coda: trained nonlinear decoder; only pass-end coda readouts are native exits; other cells are interrupted-core interventions
interpretation.native_agreement: within-model token IDs on jointly eligible items; next-token agreement is not whole-answer correctness
interpretation.same_opportunity: seven fixed sources; fractions do not equate compute, native recurrence or semantic depth
interpretation.target: Ouro191 is self-identity; Huginn31 remains a strict source upstream of target33 after the coda
interpretation.unavailable: no Huginn per-source full-distribution KL or top-k overlap; no cross-vocabulary token-ID comparison

prediction_verbatim: If J-Lens recovers content outside the native output basis, its advantage over raw logit lens should be larger in Huginn than in Ouro.
